questions.question: "It is widely believed that the policy will be reversed" is an example of:
questions.explanation: See the Passive lesson for the underlying rule.

questions.question: "The suspect is alleged to have left the country" distances the speaker from the claim's source by:
questions.explanation: See the Passive lesson for the underlying rule.
answers: Using a passive reporting verb + infinitive

questions.question: "My bike got stolen last week" is:
questions.explanation: See the Passive lesson for the underlying rule.
answers: An informal "get" passive, implying something happened unexpectedly

questions.question: Rewrite "People say that the deal fell through" as a passive reporting structure:
questions.explanation: See the Passive lesson for the underlying rule.
answers: It is said that the deal fell through.
The deal was said by people.
People are said to fall through.
It said the deal fell through.
